title.zh-TW: 隔離或移除伺服器端引用的純客戶端模組
title.en: Isolate or remove client-only mod from dedicated server

why.zh-TW: 伺服器端環境嘗試載入僅存在於客戶端的類別（如渲染、聲音或介面代碼），造成專用伺服器崩潰。
why.en: Dedicated server attempted to load client-only classes such as rendering or GUI code, halting server boot.

action.zh-TW: 讀取崩潰堆疊行號並比對模組呼叫來源
action.en: Read crash stack line and identify calling mod

how.zh-TW: 依日誌行號定位 NoClassDefFoundError net.minecraft.client 呼叫者，確認是由哪個模組所觸發
how.en: Locate the NoClassDefFoundError net.minecraft.client caller using log line numbers to determine which mod triggered it

action.zh-TW: 查驗該模組之發行元資料與 side 支援性
action.en: Check mod release metadata and side support

how.zh-TW: 檢視該模組之 toml/json 宣告或官方文件，確認其是否僅標註為客戶端專用模組
how.en: Inspect mod metadata or documentation to verify whether it is declared as client-only

action.zh-TW: 從伺服器端目錄移除或隔離純客戶端模組
action.en: Remove or isolate client-only mod from server directory

how.zh-TW: 在隔離測試目錄中將該純客戶端模組 JAR 移出 mods/，或改用伺服器專用分發
how.en: In an isolated test directory, move the client-only mod JAR out of mods/ or switch to a server build

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱重開伺服器進行驗證
action.en: Verify server boot in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在拋棄式沙箱環境重跑啟動流程，確認伺服器通過客戶端類別載入階段
how.en: Run server boot in a disposable sandbox to verify startup proceeds past the client class load stage

verify.zh-TW: 伺服器啟動日誌不再出現 net.minecraft.client 相關之 ClassNotFoundException 或 NoClassDefFoundError
verify.en: Server startup log no longer reports ClassNotFoundException or NoClassDefFoundError for net.minecraft.client

stop_if.zh-TW: 該缺失類別屬於核心 API 或雙端通用庫而非獨立客戶端模組
stop_if.en: The missing class belongs to a core API or dual-sided library rather than a client-only mod

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要僅在設定檔關閉功能卻將客戶端模組 JAR 留在伺服器 mods/ 目錄（模組載入器仍會掃描類別）
do_not.en: Do not merely toggle configs while leaving client-only mod JARs inside the server mods/ directory (loader still scans classes)

do_not.zh-TW: 不要嘗試藉由修改 JVM 啟動參數（如虛擬顯示變數）來規避客戶端圖形類別載入
do_not.en: Do not attempt to bypass client GUI class loading by tweaking JVM launch arguments or virtual display flags

title.zh-TW: 隔離未支援 DEDICATED_SERVER 環境的模組
title.en: Isolate mod unsupported on DEDICATED_SERVER environment

why.zh-TW: 模組中包含 @OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT) 標註或僅適用於客戶端發行版的類別，在專用伺服器載入時被環境守衛拒絕。
why.en: Mod contains @OnlyIn(Dist.CLIENT) or client-dist code that was rejected by the dedicated server environment guard.

action.zh-TW: 讀取日誌 invalid dist 錯誤行號與觸發類別
action.en: Read invalid dist error line and target class from log

how.zh-TW: 檢視日誌標註之 Attempted to load class for invalid dist 行號，查出引發衝突之模組
how.en: Inspect the log line for Attempted to load class for invalid dist to identify the offending mod

action.zh-TW: 核對該模組發行版本是否提供 Dedicated Server 專用版
action.en: Check upstream releases for dedicated server build

how.zh-TW: 查詢模組官方發行頁面，確認是否有單獨的伺服器版本或設定可關閉客戶端鉤子
how.en: Check upstream release notes to see if a dedicated server build or config toggle exists

action.zh-TW: 在測試環境更新或移出不支援伺服器端之模組
action.en: Update or move out unsupported mod in test environment

how.zh-TW: 在獨立沙箱目錄更新為支援伺服器端之建置版本，或將其自 mods/ 目錄暫時移出
how.en: In an isolated test sandbox, update to a server-compatible build or move the mod out of mods/

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱重跑伺服器載入驗證
action.en: Verify server loading in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在沙箱重啟伺服器，確認不再觸發 Dist 守衛攔截
how.en: Restart server in sandbox to confirm Dist guard exceptions no longer occur

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌不再出現 invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER 或 Attempted to load class for invalid dist
verify.en: Startup log no longer reports invalid dist DEDICATED_SERVER or Attempted to load class for invalid dist

stop_if.zh-TW: 本整合包為純客戶端單人遊戲整合包，不支援專用伺服器部署
stop_if.en: The modpack is intended exclusively for singleplayer client use and does not support dedicated servers

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要僅在設定檔中停用模組卻保留 JAR 於伺服器 mods/ 目錄（Dist 守衛會在載入期直接阻擋）
do_not.en: Do not merely disable mod options in config while retaining the JAR in server mods/ (Dist guard intercepts during load phase)

do_not.zh-TW: 不要嘗試手動解壓 JAR 刪除或修改 @OnlyIn 標註類別以強行載入伺服器
do_not.en: Do not manually decompress JARs or strip @OnlyIn annotation classes to force loading on dedicated server

title.zh-TW: 校準 Java 執行環境版本以符合模組位元組碼要求
title.en: Align Java runtime version with mod bytecode requirements

why.zh-TW: 模組編譯之 class file version 高於當前執行伺服器的 Java 虛擬機版本（如 class version 65 需 Java 21）。
why.en: Mod class file version is newer than the host JVM version (e.g. class version 65 requires Java 21).

action.zh-TW: 讀取 UnsupportedClassVersionError 版本號與當前 Java 版本
action.en: Read class version number from UnsupportedClassVersionError and current Java version

how.zh-TW: 比對日誌中之 class file version（例如 61 對應 Java 17、65 對應 Java 21），記錄目標 Java 版本
how.en: Extract class file version from log (e.g., 61 corresponds to Java 17, 65 to Java 21) to determine target Java version

action.zh-TW: 盤點主機或容器環境中可用之 JDK/JRE 版本
action.en: Inspect available JDK/JRE installations on host or container

how.zh-TW: 查詢環境中已安裝之 Java 執行檔路徑，確認是否存在相容之 Java 執行環境
how.en: Check available Java binary paths in environment to verify if a compatible runtime is installed

action.zh-TW: 調整啟動腳本或容器映像之 Java 執行環境
action.en: Configure startup script or container image to use target Java runtime

how.zh-TW: 在啟動環境或容器設定中切換 JAVA_HOME 至符合要求之 Java 版本
how.en: Update JAVA_HOME or container image tag in launch configuration to the required Java version

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱驗證 Java 版本與伺服器啟動
action.en: Verify Java runtime and server boot in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 執行 java -version 檢驗，並於沙箱啟動伺服器確認類別可正常解析
how.en: Run java -version and launch server in disposable sandbox to confirm classes load without version errors

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌顯示 Java 執行版本符合模組需求，且無 UnsupportedClassVersionError
verify.en: Startup log indicates Java runtime satisfies requirements and no UnsupportedClassVersionError occurs

stop_if.zh-TW: 既有模組載入器（如舊版 Forge）不支援新版 Java 執行環境
stop_if.en: Existing mod loader (such as legacy Forge) does not support the newer Java runtime

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要未先查驗模組載入器（Loader）相容性就直接更換啟動腳本中的 Java 大版本
do_not.en: Do not switch Java major versions in launch scripts without first verifying mod loader compatibility

do_not.zh-TW: 不要嘗試使用位元組碼降級工具或 JVM 旗標強行在舊版 JRE 執行高版本 class 檔
do_not.en: Do not attempt to run higher-version class files on an older JRE using bytecode downgraders or JVM bypass flags

title.zh-TW: 分析 Mixin 注入失敗原因並排解模組衝突
title.en: Analyze Mixin injection failure and resolve mod conflicts

why.zh-TW: 多個模組嘗試轉換相同的 Minecraft 位元組碼方法，導致 Mixin 注入目標衝突或簽名不符。
why.en: Multiple mods attempted to transform the same bytecode target, causing Mixin injection failure or signature mismatch.

action.zh-TW: 從日誌提取注入失敗之 Mixin 配置檔與目標方法
action.en: Extract failing Mixin config and target method from log

how.zh-TW: 檢視 MixinApplyError 區塊，記錄涉及之 mixin 設定檔名稱、注入器類別與目標 Minecraft 類別
how.en: Inspect MixinApplyError lines to record the mixin config name, injector class, and target Minecraft class

action.zh-TW: 比對涉及該目標類別的已安裝模組
action.en: Correlate installed mods targeting the same class

how.zh-TW: 檢索近期變更或新增之模組，尋找修改同類目標的衝突模組組合
how.en: Review recently added or updated mods to identify conflicting combinations modifying the same target

action.zh-TW: 依衝突模組官方相容性公告更新或隔離問題模組
action.en: Update or isolate offending mod per upstream compatibility guidance

how.zh-TW: 在測試環境中更新相容修正版本，或暫時隔離其中一個衝突模組
how.en: In test environment, update to compatible build or temporarily isolate one conflicting mod

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱重跑 Mixin 轉換驗證
action.en: Verify Mixin transformation in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 啟動測試伺服器確認所有 Mixin 均成功套用且無 Critical injection failure
how.en: Boot test server to verify all Mixin transformers succeed without Critical injection failure

verify.zh-TW: 日誌中不再出現 MixinApplyError、MixinTransformerError 或 Critical injection failure
verify.en: Logs no longer contain MixinApplyError, MixinTransformerError, or Critical injection failure

stop_if.zh-TW: Mixin 失敗源自載入器核心子系統損壞而非個別模組衝突
stop_if.en: The Mixin failure stems from corruption in loader subsystem itself rather than individual mod conflict

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要在缺乏日誌 MixinApplyError 具體證據前同時批次升降級多個模組
do_not.en: Do not batch upgrade or downgrade multiple mods simultaneously without log evidence identifying the specific failing Mixin config

do_not.zh-TW: 不要在未確認注入目標衝突來源前直接移除底層渲染或最佳化相依核心
do_not.en: Do not remove foundational optimization or library mods before identifying which injector caused the target mismatch

title.zh-TW: 校正模組載入器版本與整合包相容目標
title.en: Align mod loader version with modpack target compatibility

why.zh-TW: 當前安裝之模組載入器（Loader）版本過舊，或未滿足模組宣告之版本要求範圍。
why.en: Installed mod loader version is outdated or does not satisfy version ranges declared by mods.

action.zh-TW: 讀取日誌列出之載入器版本與模組要求範圍
action.en: Read loader version and mod constraints from log

how.zh-TW: 檢視 Incompatible mods found 區塊，記錄各模組要求之載入器最低版本
how.en: Inspect Incompatible mods found block to identify minimum required loader versions

action.zh-TW: 核對當前伺服器安裝之核心版本
action.en: Check currently installed server loader build

how.zh-TW: 檢查啟動核心檔案名稱或 run.sh / user_jvm_args.txt 中定義之載入器版本
how.en: Inspect server startup jar filename or launch scripts to confirm current loader build

action.zh-TW: 在測試環境更新載入器核心至相容版本
action.en: Update loader core to compatible version in test environment

how.zh-TW: 在隔離測試沙箱中使用官方安裝器更新 Forge/NeoForge/Fabric 核心
how.en: Update Forge/NeoForge/Fabric core using official installer in isolated test sandbox

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱重開驗證載入器相容性
action.en: Verify loader compatibility in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在沙箱重啟伺服器，確認載入器相容性驗證完全通過
how.en: Reboot server in sandbox to confirm loader compatibility checks pass completely

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌不再出現 Incompatible mods found 或 unsupported mod loader 警告
verify.en: Startup log no longer reports Incompatible mods found or unsupported mod loader warnings

stop_if.zh-TW: 提高載入器版本會導致 Minecraft 遊戲版本不相容
stop_if.en: Increasing loader version breaks compatibility with Minecraft target version

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要跨越 Minecraft 主版本強制升級載入器核心（如從 1.20.1 跨至 1.20.4）
do_not.en: Do not force-upgrade the loader core across Minecraft minor/major version boundaries (e.g. 1.20.1 to 1.20.4)

do_not.zh-TW: 不要直接套用未經相容性驗證的最新實驗版載入器核心
do_not.en: Do not blindly install bleeding-edge experimental loader builds without verifying modpack target constraints

title.zh-TW: 依日誌所指補齊缺漏之相依類別與依賴閉包
title.en: Complete dependency closure for missing class based on log evidence

why.zh-TW: 模組在執行時嘗試引用不存在的 Java 類別，通常因為缺少必要相依函式庫或前置模組未安裝。
why.en: A mod attempted to reference a missing Java class at runtime because a required dependency library is absent.

action.zh-TW: 記錄缺漏之類別全名與呼叫來源模組
action.en: Record missing class name and calling mod

how.zh-TW: 從 NoClassDefFoundError / ClassNotFoundException 提取完整類別路徑與調用堆疊
how.en: Extract fully qualified class name and calling stack from NoClassDefFoundError / ClassNotFoundException

action.zh-TW: 比對模組宣告之依賴項，補齊依賴閉包且版本以日誌為準
action.en: Match declared mod dependencies to complete dependency closure based on log

how.zh-TW: 檢視呼叫來源模組的 mods.toml 或 fabric.mod.json，依日誌與宣告補齊依賴閉包，版本以日誌為準（不要猜測 slug）
how.en: Inspect calling mod metadata to complete dependency closure strictly based on log evidence and declared versions without guessing slugs

action.zh-TW: 在測試沙箱補齊缺漏之相依 JAR
action.en: Place required dependency JAR in test sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在獨立沙箱的 mods/ 目錄中放置符合相容版本之依賴檔案
how.en: Place verified compatible dependency JAR into the sandbox mods/ directory

action.zh-TW: 於一次性沙箱重跑驗證類別載入
action.en: Verify class loading in disposable sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在沙箱重啟伺服器，驗證該缺失類別可被成功解析載入
how.en: Reboot server in sandbox to verify the previously missing class resolves cleanly

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌不再出現該類別之 NoClassDefFoundError 或 ClassNotFoundException
verify.en: Startup log no longer reports NoClassDefFoundError or ClassNotFoundException for that class

stop_if.zh-TW: 缺失類別屬於 JRE 內建模組或已被移除之舊版標準庫 API
stop_if.en: The missing class belongs to internal JRE modules or deprecated standard APIs

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要憑檔名或印象猜測依賴名稱，必須依據堆疊中的完整類別路徑查驗依賴閉包
do_not.en: Do not guess dependency names or slugs from memory; verify the exact dependency closure using the full class path in the stack trace

do_not.zh-TW: 不要嘗試將現有模組全部無差別升級到最新發行版以解決單一類別缺漏
do_not.en: Do not indiscriminately upgrade all installed mods to their latest releases to resolve a single missing class

title.zh-TW: 依日誌明確指引補齊缺漏之必要前置模組
title.en: Fulfill mandatory mod dependencies strictly indicated by log

why.zh-TW: 模組載入器在早期驗證階段發現缺少必要前置模組（mandatory dependencies）或版本不符合要求。
why.en: Mod loader detected missing mandatory dependencies or version mismatches during early dependency check.

action.zh-TW: 讀取日誌列出之缺漏模組清單與要求版本範圍
action.en: Read missing dependencies list and requested version ranges from log

how.zh-TW: 從 Missing mandatory dependencies 區塊中提取缺漏之 Mod ID 與版本條件，補齊依賴閉包，版本以日誌為準（不要猜測 slug）
how.en: Parse missing Mod ID and version constraints from log to complete dependency closure strictly based on log without guessing slugs

action.zh-TW: 檢查 mods 目錄確認是否已存在但不相容之版本
action.en: Check mods directory for incompatible existing versions

how.zh-TW: 盤點本地 mods/ 目錄，確認該依賴是完全缺失還是現有版本不符要求
how.en: Inspect local mods/ directory to confirm whether dependency is missing or installed version is out of range

action.zh-TW: 在隔離測試環境補齊相容之必要前置模組
action.en: Install compatible mandatory dependency in isolated test environment

how.zh-TW: 在沙箱測試目錄中補齊符合日誌所列版本範圍的前置模組 JAR
how.en: Place required dependency JAR matching log-specified range into test sandbox

action.zh-TW: 驗證載入器依賴圖滿足且無衝突
action.en: Verify dependency graph resolves without conflict

how.zh-TW: 在一次性沙箱重啟伺服器確認所有必要相依均已滿足
how.en: Reboot server in disposable sandbox to verify all mandatory dependencies are fulfilled

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌不再出現 Missing mandatory dependencies 警告
verify.en: Startup log no longer reports Missing mandatory dependencies warnings

stop_if.zh-TW: 兩個必要模組互相要求互斥的依賴版本範圍（依賴死結）
stop_if.en: Two required mods demand mutually exclusive dependency version ranges (dependency deadlock)

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要忽視日誌標示的嚴格版本範圍約束而直接下載最新發布版依賴
do_not.en: Do not disregard the strict version range constraints specified in the log by downloading unverified latest dependency releases

do_not.zh-TW: 不要憑直覺猜測前置模組 slug 或下載不同模組載入器專用的依賴檔案
do_not.en: Do not guess dependency slugs or download dependency files built for a different mod loader

title.zh-TW: 提高記憶體上限，但先量測主機餘裕
title.en: Raise the heap only after measuring host headroom

why.zh-TW: Java 虛擬機堆積記憶體（Heap Space）耗盡，導致伺服器崩潰或無法完成啟動。
why.en: The Java virtual machine exhausted its allocated heap space, causing a crash or incomplete startup.

action.zh-TW: 讀取當前 JVM 參數與主機實體記憶體餘裕
action.en: Read current JVM parameters and host memory headroom

how.zh-TW: 檢查啟動參數中之 -Xmx 設定，並以系統指令確認主機可用實體記憶體
how.en: Inspect current -Xmx launch setting and check available host physical memory via system commands

action.zh-TW: 計算合宜之堆積記憶體上限
action.en: Calculate safe heap upper bound

how.zh-TW: 在主機實體記憶體安全預算內（保留作業系統所需空間）規劃新的 -Xmx 數值
how.en: Plan a new -Xmx allocation that leaves sufficient headroom for host operating system

action.zh-TW: 於設定檔調整 -Xmx 堆積記憶體分配
action.en: Adjust -Xmx allocation in configuration

how.zh-TW: 在 user_jvm_args.txt 或啟動腳本中適度提高 -Xmx 參數
how.en: Increase -Xmx parameter in user_jvm_args.txt or launch script within measured host limits

action.zh-TW: 監測沙箱啟動峰值記憶體
action.en: Monitor peak memory usage in sandbox startup

how.zh-TW: 於一次性測試沙箱啟動伺服器並觀測記憶體使用趨勢與 GC 表現
how.en: Boot in disposable test sandbox and observe heap usage curve and GC behavior

verify.zh-TW: 伺服器啟動過程無 OutOfMemoryError 或 Java heap space 錯誤
verify.en: Server starts without OutOfMemoryError or Java heap space errors

stop_if.zh-TW: 主機剩餘可用實體記憶體不足以支撐更高的堆積配置
stop_if.en: Host available physical memory is insufficient to safely support higher heap allocation

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要在未量測主機實體記憶體可用餘裕前直接將 -Xmx 翻倍或設為全主機記憶體
do_not.en: Do not double -Xmx or allocate total host physical RAM before measuring available host memory headroom

do_not.zh-TW: 不要將記憶體耗盡誤判為模組邏輯衝突而隨意停用或移除功能模組
do_not.en: Do not mistake memory exhaustion for mod conflicts by arbitrarily disabling functional mods

title.zh-TW: 分析模組異常堆疊並隔離出錯模組
title.en: Analyze mod exception stack trace and isolate faulty mod

why.zh-TW: 特定模組在生命週期階段（如 setup / load / registry）拋出未捕獲之異常，終止伺服器初始化。
why.en: A specific mod threw an unhandled exception during its lifecycle phase, halting server initialization.

action.zh-TW: 從日誌中標註出錯之 Mod ID 與異常堆疊
action.en: Identify faulty Mod ID and exception stack from log

how.zh-TW: 檢索 Mod encountered an error 訊息，記錄出錯模組名稱與異常類別
how.en: Locate the Mod encountered an error line and identify offending mod ID and exception type

action.zh-TW: 檢查該模組之配置檔與相容性記錄
action.en: Check mod configuration and compatibility notes

how.zh-TW: 檢視該模組 config/ 設定檔是否有語法錯誤，並查閱該版本已知 Issue
how.en: Review mod config file syntax and consult upstream issue tracker for known version defects

action.zh-TW: 在測試環境嘗試還原預設設定或隔離該模組
action.en: Reset config to default or isolate mod in test sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在隔離測試沙箱中備份後重設設定檔，若仍異常則暫時移出該模組進行比對
how.en: In test sandbox, back up and reset config; if errors persist, isolate mod JAR for comparison

action.zh-TW: 於沙箱環境重跑生命週期載入
action.en: Verify lifecycle loading in sandbox

how.zh-TW: 在一次性沙箱重啟伺服器確認生命週期初始化順利完成
how.en: Restart server in disposable sandbox to confirm lifecycle initialization completes

verify.zh-TW: 啟動日誌不再出現 Mod encountered an error 或 Failed to load mod 紀錄
verify.en: Startup log no longer contains Mod encountered an error or Failed to load mod records

stop_if.zh-TW: 異常是由全域資料庫、存檔損壞或硬體磁碟錯誤引起而非模組本身缺陷
stop_if.en: The exception is caused by global database, world file corruption, or disk errors rather than mod defects

do_not.zh-TW: 不要刪除或改寫正式世界的 world/ 目錄
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite the production world/ directory

do_not.zh-TW: 不要一次停用全部模組（bulk disable）
do_not.en: Do not bulk-disable all mods at once

do_not.zh-TW: 不要僅憑單一異常堆疊的頂層類別就斷定是該模組程式缺陷並直接將其刪除
do_not.en: Do not blame and delete a mod solely based on the top class in a single exception trace without reproducing in isolation

do_not.zh-TW: 不要在沒有備份原設定的情況下直接刪除或覆寫該模組的 config/ 設定檔
do_not.en: Do not delete or overwrite mod config/ files in-place without backing up the original settings
